description: Create a shop. The caller becomes its one owner. The caller must already have accepted the current Terms and Privacy on the sign-in page. Until then this call is refused. On the sign-up page the person can also record the shop Terms of Service (accept_terms_version) with the version, time, IP address and browser. An agent cannot agree to those shop terms for them.

accept_terms_version.description: Sign-up page only: the Terms of Service version the person agreed to

name: shops_create
